data.summary: Add labels to a wiki page, recording each change in the page's label history
data.effectNote: appends one entry to the page's label history, none when every label is there already; never rewrites an entry

options.name: label
options.help: A label, lowercase group:value (topic:setup, status:draft); repeat the option for several labels

options.name: reason
options.help: Why, one sentence (kept in the history)

examples: acme page label getting-started --label topic:setup --label status:draft --reason "First draft of the setup guide" --json
